docs.text: ← Arcaelas Legal Soporte — La Arepera ¿Necesitas ayuda con La Arepera? Escríbenos a miguel.guevara@arcaelas.com · arko.arcaelas.com . Cuéntanos qué ocurrió, el modelo de tu teléfono y la versión de su sistema, y te respondemos por correo. Preguntas frecuentes ¿Cómo se juega? Desliza el dedo en cualquier parte de la pantalla para mover al arepero. Todo ocurre al pararte en una zona: cosecha el maíz, llévalo al pilón, la masa al budare y las arepas al mostrador. Con lo que cobras construyes mesas, estaciones y la granja, y subes de nivel tu arepera. ¿Cómo contrato empleados? Construye la Oficina de Recursos Humanos y párate en el escritorio. Puedes tener hasta 5 empleados, subirlos de nivel uno por uno y despedirlos cuando quieras. Ojo: cada quincena cobran una comisión de las ventas, y el que pasa la quincena sin trabajo cobra el doble. ¿Por qué despidieron a un empleado? Si el día de pago no te alcanza el dinero para la nómina, se va el empleado que más cobra y pierde su nivel. Si lo despides tú, conserva su nivel para cuando lo vuelvas a contratar. Mis clientes pagan poco Los clientes pagan más cuando los atiendes rápido y cuando el menú es variado. Si siempre vendes la misma arepa, se aburren. ¿Se guarda mi progreso? Sí, automáticamente en tu teléfono. Si borras los datos de la app o la desinstalas, el progreso se pierde. ¿El juego tiene compras o anuncios? No. La Arepera es gratuita: no vende nada dentro de la app y no muestra anuncios. Los billetes se ganan jugando. No veo mis logros Inicia sesión en Google Play Juegos (Android) o Game Center (iPhone) desde Ajustes. Los logros que ganaste sin conexión se envían cuando vuelve internet. Support — La Arepera Need help with La Arepera? Write to us at miguel.guevara@arcaelas.com · arko.arcaelas.com . Tell us what happened, your phone model and its system version, and we'll reply by email. Frequently asked questions How do I play? Slide your finger anywhere on the screen to move the arepero. Everything happens when you stand on a zone: harvest the corn, take it to the mortar, the dough to the griddle and the arepas to the counter. With what you earn you build tables, stations and the farm, and level up your arepera. How do I hire employees? Build the Human Resources Office and stand at the desk. You can have up to 5 employees, level them up one by one and dismiss them whenever you want. Note: every payday they earn a commission on sales, and anyone who spends the pay period idle earns double. Why was an employee fired? If you can't cover payroll on payday, the highest-paid employee leaves and loses their level. If you dismiss them yourself, they keep their level for when you hire them again. My customers pay little Customers pay more when you serve them fast and the menu is varied. If you always sell the same arepa, they get bored. Is my progress saved? Yes, automatically on your phone. If you clear the app data or uninstall it, the progress is lost. Does the game have purchases or ads? No. La Arepera is free: it sells nothing inside the app and shows no ads. Cash is earned by playing. I can't see my achievements Sign in to Google Play Games (Android) or Game Center (iPhone) from Settings. Achievements earned offline are sent when the connection comes back.

Your game: the world with your buildings, your position, your inventory, the chests and the blocks you invent. Your character's skin. The last 30 chat messages of each online room you played in. Online play To play online you create a room, which shows a four letter code, or you join a room with its code. Your position, where you are looking and your movements, several times per second. Your character's skin and the game version. The chat messages you write, up to 80 characters, with your name. We use this data only to make online play work: the server passes it on to the players in the room, who see your character, your name, your buildings and your messages. The server keeps each room's world (its seed, the changed blocks, the treasures and the loose items) so it can be resumed with its code; that world holds no names or messages. The server's technical log records the name someone joins or leaves a room with, along with the time and the room code. Chat messages are not stored on the server: they are only forwarded to the players in the room. docs.text: Your profile: your player name, if you typed one (up to 10 letters), your experience, your game counters (knockdowns, deaths, wins, blocks and play time) and your settings: volume, quality, sensitivity, world and game mode. Your game: the world with your buildings, your position, your inventory, the chests and the blocks you invent. Your character's skin. The last 30 chat messages of each online room you played in. docs.text: To play online you create a room, which shows a four letter code, or you join a room with its code. First, the game looks up the current address of its server on api.keyval.org , a public third-party service that stores values by name; that lookup carries no data about you. Then it connects to our game server through a Cloudflare tunnel ( trycloudflare.com ). While you are in a room, the game sends: The room code and, when you create it, the seed its world is generated from. Your player name, if you typed one. If not, the server names you «Jugador» with a number, and in the chat you show up with an automatic name such as «JUGADOR123». Your position, where you are looking and your movements, several times per second. The blocks you place or break, the blocks you invent, the chests and treasures you open, the lights you turn on, shots and hits, and the room's time of day and weather. Your character's skin and the game version. The chat messages you write, up to 80 characters, with your name. We use this data only to make online play work: the server passes it on to the players in the room, who see your character, your name, your buildings and your messages. The server keeps each room's world (its seed, the changed blocks, the treasures and the loose items) so it can be resumed with its code; that world holds no names or messages. The server's technical log records the name someone joins or leaves a room with, along with the time and the room code. Chat messages are not stored on the server: they are only forwarded to the players in the room. As with any internet connection, api.keyval.org , Cloudflare and our server receive your device's IP address and the technical data that come with the connection. Cloudflare handles that information under its Privacy Policy .

docs.text: ← Arcaelas Legal Soporte — ChessAI ¿Necesitas ayuda con ChessAI? Escríbenos a miguel.guevara@arcaelas.com · arko.arcaelas.com . Cuéntanos qué ocurrió, el modelo de tu teléfono y la versión de su sistema, y te respondemos por correo. Preguntas frecuentes ¿Cómo empiezo una partida? En la pantalla de inicio, toca Nueva Partida para jugar contra la IA o Modo 2 Jugadores para jugar con otra persona en el mismo teléfono. Toca una pieza para ver sus movimientos posibles y luego la casilla de destino. ¿Cómo cambio la dificultad? En Configuración → Juego , toca las estrellas: hay cinco niveles, de Principiante (ELO 800 aproximado) a Maestro (ELO 2400 aproximado). En los niveles altos la IA tarda más en pensar su jugada. ¿Puedo limitar el tiempo o los movimientos? Sí. En Configuración → Juego eliges el tiempo máximo de la partida (de 15 a 60 minutos) y el máximo de movimientos por jugador (de 10 a 150). ¿Cómo retomo una partida que dejé a medias? Las partidas se guardan solas. En el inicio aparece Continuar Partida cuando tienes alguna en curso; también puedes abrirlas desde Estadísticas . ¿Cómo promociono un peón? Con Autopromoción activada (viene así de fábrica), el peón se convierte en dama al llegar a la última fila. Si la desactivas en Configuración → Interfaz , la app te deja elegir entre dama, torre, alfil o caballo. ¿Puedo girar el tablero o ver las coordenadas? Sí, en Configuración → Interfaz : mostrar movimientos posibles, mostrar coordenadas y girar el tablero. ¿Cómo cambio el tema o el idioma? En Configuración eliges el tema (claro, oscuro o el del sistema) y el idioma (español o inglés). En el inicio, el botón de la luna o del sol cambia entre claro y oscuro. ¿Hace falta internet? No. La IA juega dentro de tu teléfono y la app funciona sin conexión. En iPhone, la app puede descargar una vez la tipografía de Google Fonts; sin conexión usa la del sistema. ¿Dónde se guardan mis partidas? En tu teléfono. No hay cuenta ni servidores: si desinstalas la app o borras sus datos, las partidas y estadísticas se pierden y no podemos recuperarlas. Las copias de seguridad del sistema (iCloud o Google) pueden incluirlas si las tienes activadas. ¿Cómo borro mis datos? En Configuración → Datos → Eliminar todos los datos . Más detalles en la página de eliminación de datos . Support — ChessAI Need help with ChessAI? Write to us at miguel.guevara@arcaelas.com · arko.arcaelas.com . Tell us what happened, your phone model and its system version, and we'll reply by email. Frequently asked questions How do I start a game? On the home screen, tap New Game to play against the AI or 2 Player Mode to play with another person on the same phone. Tap a piece to see its possible moves and then the target square. How do I change the difficulty? In Settings → Game , tap the stars: there are five levels, from Beginner (about 800 ELO) to Master (about 2400 ELO). At the higher levels the AI takes longer to think about its move. Can I limit the time or the moves? Yes. In Settings → Game you choose the maximum game time (15 to 60 minutes) and the maximum moves per player (10 to 150). How do I resume an unfinished game? Games are saved automatically. The home screen shows Continue Game when you have one in progress; you can also open them from Statistics . How do I promote a pawn? With Auto-promotion on (the default), the pawn becomes a queen when it reaches the last rank. If you turn it off in Settings → Interface , the app lets you choose a queen, rook, bishop or knight. Can I flip the board or see the coordinates? Yes, in Settings → Interface : show possible moves, show coordinates and flip the board. How do I change the theme or the language? In Settings you choose the theme (light, dark or system) and the language (Spanish or English). On the home screen, the moon or sun button switches between light and dark. Do I need internet? No. The AI plays inside your phone and the app works offline. On iPhone, the app may download the Google Fonts typeface once; without a connection it uses the system typeface. Where are my games saved? On your phone. There is no account and no server: if you uninstall the app or clear its data, your games and statistics are lost and we cannot recover them. System backups (iCloud or Google) may include them if you have them turned on. How do I delete my data? In Settings → Data → Delete all data . More details on the data deletion page .

docs.text: The display name you choose for the table. Your settings, such as sound. The message history of the game, so you can review what was written at the table. The invitation to the table you joined, to get back in if the connection drops. This data lives in the app's storage on your device.
docs.title: Data the game stores on your device

docs.text: Network games are played between phones connected to the same Wi-Fi network. The phone of the player who creates the table (the host) receives the connections of the other players within that network and runs the game. Display names, moves, the tiles each player drags over the table and messages travel directly between those phones and never go through the internet or any server. Each player receives only what they are meant to see: no one receives the other players' tiles. The QR code and the short code of each seat contain the host's address on the local network and a single-use invitation. They contain no personal data.

docs.text: Messages you write at the table, up to 20 characters, are received by every player in that game. There are no private messages. We do not store or review them: they are sent only between the phones in the game, and each player keeps their own copy of the history on their device.

docs.text: The camera is used only to scan the QR code that lets you join a table. The image is processed on your device: no photos are taken, stored or sent. That data travels encrypted and Google states it does not transfer it to third parties. On iPhone, the reader uses Vision, an Apple component included in the system, which processes the image on the device and sends no data.

Puedes jugar solo contra la computadora o en red local con 2 o 4 personas. Toca crear partida, elige en cada puesto si lo ocupa una persona o la computadora y define cuánto vale la partida. Tap create game, choose for each seat whether a person or the computer takes it and set how much the game is worth. The game generates a QR code and a short code for each human seat: each friend scans theirs or types it by hand. I can't join a table All phones must be connected to the same Wi-Fi network. The connection dropped in the middle of the game Open the game again: the table waits for you and you get back in with your saved invitation. The host must keep the game open with the screen on, because their phone holds the table. What is a "cabra"? A misplaced tile that doesn't match the end. As at a real table, the game lets you play it. It is subtly marked for everyone, and only the player who placed it can take it back before the next tile is played. Why aren't playable tiles highlighted? Because the game behaves like a real table: following the rules is up to the players. Do I need internet? No. Against the computer you play offline, and over the network you only need a shared Wi-Fi.

The islands you raid and their defenders are run by the game itself on your device: there are no other players, chat or social features. Data the game stores on your device Your jarl's name, if you type it in the settings (up to 18 characters). It is optional and only shown on your screen. The language you choose, Spanish or English. If you choose none, the game uses the system language. Your progress: your island and what you built on it, the record of the resources, troops, boats and diamonds you earned and spent, your fleets, the islands of the archipelago and the time your world was last updated. Copies of the game's data files: the catalog, the shop and the sheet of each element. This data lives in the app's storage on your device: on Android, in the app's own folder ( Android/data/com.arcaelas.valhalla/files/ ) and in its preferences; on iPhone, in the app's documents folder and in its preferences. It never leaves your device towards us. Device time The game uses your device's time to work out constructions, resource production, fleet voyages and the rotation of the port offers. The time is read on the device and is not sent anywhere. System backups If you have system backups turned on, Android (Google backup) or iPhone (iCloud or the backup on your computer) may include the game's data in your device backup, so it can be restored when you change phones. Those backups are managed by Google or Apple in your account and under their own policies; we have no access to them. You can turn them off in the system settings. System permissions Valhalla requests no permission: no internet, storage, camera, microphone, location, contacts or notifications. On Android, the published game does not declare the internet permission, so it cannot connect to the network. The game sends no notifications. Purchases, diamonds and ads The game is free, has no in-app purchases and shows no ads. Gold, the other resources and diamonds are virtual currency: they are earned by playing (diamonds, for example, by leveling up, raiding islands and completing missions and achievements), are only usable inside the game, cannot be bought with real money and have no monetary value. Sharing with third parties We do not sell or share data, since we collect none. The game includes no third-party components that send data. The store you download it from (Google Play or the App Store) handles your store account data under its own privacy policy. Security Since the game's data never leaves your device, it does not travel over any network and is protected by the operating system's security mechanisms. On Android, the app's own folder holds only the game's progress and data files; it can be seen by connecting the phone to a computer and, on Android 10 or earlier, also by other apps with storage permission. Retention and deletion While the game is installed, your data stays on the device. To delete it, clear the app data from the system settings or uninstall the app: uninstalling also makes the system delete its own folder. Since we keep nothing of yours, we have no data to delete on our side and cannot recover your progress. More details on the data deletion page . Children's privacy Valhalla collects no personal data from anyone, of any age, shows no ads and offers no purchases. Changes to this policy If we update this policy, we'll publish the new version at this same URL and update the effective date. docs.text: ← Arcaelas Legal Soporte — Valhalla ¿Necesitas ayuda con Valhalla? Escríbenos a miguel.guevara@arcaelas.com · arko.arcaelas.com . Cuéntanos qué ocurrió, el modelo de tu teléfono y la versión de su sistema, y te respondemos por correo. Preguntas frecuentes ¿Cómo se juega? Empiezas con una pequeña isla vikinga. Construye cabañas, la tienda vikinga, minas, torres de vigía y empalizadas, pon a tus vikingos a talar, minar, cultivar, cazar y pescar, y amplía tu isla expansión tras expansión. Recluta guerreros, mejóralos nivel a nivel y zarpa a conquistar las islas del archipiélago. Tu cuenta sube de nivel con los puntos de batalla, hasta el nivel 30. ¿Mi aldea sigue trabajando si cierro el juego? Sí. Tus vikingos siguen trabajando y las obras siguen avanzando mientras no juegas. Al volver encontrarás los recursos acumulados y las obras terminadas. ¿Cómo conquisto una isla? Abre la carta del archipiélago, inspecciona la isla para ver su recompensa y sus defensores, elige la playa donde desembarcar y sigue la batalla en vivo. Si la batalla se pone en contra, puedes retirarte: tus caídos vuelven a casa. ¿Cómo consigo diamantes? Subiendo de nivel, saqueando islas y cumpliendo misiones y logros. Los diamantes sirven para acelerar construcciones y flotas, y no se compran con dinero real. ¿Hace falta internet? No. Valhalla funciona completamente sin conexión, no tiene anuncios ni compras dentro de la app. ¿Dónde se guarda mi progreso? En tu teléfono. No hay cuenta ni servidores: si desinstalas el juego o borras sus datos, el progreso se pierde y no podemos recuperarlo. Las copias de seguridad del sistema (iCloud o Google) pueden incluirlo si las tienes activadas. Cambié la hora del teléfono y algo se ve raro El juego usa la hora de tu dispositivo para calcular construcciones, trabajos y viajes. Deja la hora en automático para que todo avance como corresponde. ¿Cómo cambio el idioma? En los ajustes del juego puedes elegir español o inglés. Si no eliges ninguno, el juego usa el idioma del sistema. Support — Valhalla Need help with Valhalla? Write to us at miguel.guevara@arcaelas.com · arko.arcaelas.com . Tell us what happened, your phone model and its system version, and we'll reply by email. Frequently asked questions How do I play? You start with a small Viking island. Build huts, the Viking shop, mines, watchtowers and palisades, set your Vikings to chop, mine, farm, hunt and fish, and expand your island one expansion at a time. Recruit warriors, upgrade them level by level and set sail to conquer the islands of the archipelago. Your account levels up with battle points, up to level 30. Does my village keep working if I close the game? Yes. Your Vikings keep working and your buildings keep progressing while you are away. When you come back you will find the gathered resources and the finished buildings. How do I conquer an island? Open the archipelago chart, inspect the island to see its reward and its defenders, choose the beach to land on and follow the battle live. If the battle turns against you, you can retreat: your fallen return home. How do I get diamonds? By leveling up, raiding islands and completing missions and achievements. Diamonds speed up buildings and fleets, and they cannot be bought with real money. Do I need internet? No. Valhalla works completely offline, with no ads and no in-app purchases. Where is my progress saved? On your phone. There is no account and no server: if you uninstall the game or clear its data, your progress is lost and we cannot recover it. System backups (iCloud or Google) may include it if you have them turned on. I changed the phone's clock and something looks wrong The game uses your device's time to compute buildings, work and voyages. Keep the time set automatically so everything progresses as it should. How do I change the language? In the game settings you can choose Spanish or English. If you don't choose one, the game uses the system language.

Network state: know whether a VPN is turned on to show the notice and, if the VPN allows it, use the Wi-Fi network while a network game is open. Wi-Fi multicast: receive the messages devices use to find each other on the local network, only while a network game is being opened, looked for or played. Camera (optional): scan the QR code of a network game. On iPhone: Local network: find and connect the devices of a network game. To check this permission, the game advertises and browses for its own service on the local network (Bonjour, _palabreo._tcp ), which carries no personal data. Camera (optional): scan the QR code of a network game. Purchases The game has no real-money purchases. The points in the wallet are virtual, earned by playing, and only usable inside the game. Sharing with third parties We do not sell or share data. The only third parties that receive information are the ones described above: the Wikimedia Foundation, when you look up a meaning, and Google, through the QR code reader component on Android. Retention and deletion While the game is installed, your data stays on the device. To delete it, clear the app data from the system settings or uninstall the app. More details on the data deletion page . Children's privacy The game is suitable for all ages and collects no personal data from anyone, of any age.
